static_traits.name: Zhu Li
static_traits.educational_background: 正在攻读时装设计学位
static_traits.social_status: 在纽约有少数朋友可交谈，但因担心被评判与增加负担而倾向于not主动求助
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清楚，能具体描述压力源与担忧；配合度较好但整体态度消极；思维常出现灾难化与跳到结论；在考试/项目压力下易被负性自动思维占据，Sleep disturbed

basic_info.main_problem: 自从搬到纽约就读知名时装设计学院后，我一直出现压倒性的想法，觉得自己会破产、without法在学业上成功。这些想法在考试或设计项目前尤为强烈，持续担忧财务与学业表现。
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts have affected my ability to focus on studying and enjoy life in New York, so I am seeking counseling to reduce the impact and improve my focus and life experience.

core_beliefs: 我的not yet来not可控且充满风险（会破产）

special_situations.event: Moved to New York and entered a well-known fashion design institute, facing a competitive environment and high tuition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在竞争环境中表现出色并维持经济稳定，就意味着我失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying self-soothing and seeking support from friends, but soon retreating again to gritting it out alone and avoiding opening up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会破产，而且永远学not到任何东西

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在考试/项目中取得很高的成绩，我就会被退学，所有努力都白费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 熬夜担忧、强迫自己推进任务但难以集中
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会挂科，然后走向破产并not得not退学

special_situations.event: 尝试向朋友谈及自身的财务与学业担忧
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达Anxiety，朋友会觉得我夸张或not理解我，从而关系受影响
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避向朋友敞开，Reduced socializing来避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我小题大做、在给人添麻烦

special_situations.event: Reviews some past projects where performance was acceptable or normal feedback was received
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果结果not是完美，那就not算真正的能力；好的结果只是偶然
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将积极表现归因于运气，deny自身能力与努力
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 过去做得还可以只是运气，运气会用完

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and supported, while gaining safety and a sense of control in studies and finances
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged or seen as exaggerating; fears failure leading to bankruptcy and dropping out
defense_goal: 通过减少暴露与独自硬撑来维持安全感、避免被评判与negate

object_relations.object_representation: 可能会责难或not理解自己的他人/朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to seek support from friends or when interpersonal support is mentioned
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将他人视为可能的评判者，认为他们会觉得自己夸张或without能（Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和的肯定与具体化Questioning，邀请举例与证据；语气平稳、关注当下体验与关系安全，避免对抗与评判。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive evidence and abilities from one's past projects
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将正面结果解释为“只是运气”，以维持对失败的Anticipation与Self-doubt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以合作式探询区分事实与解释，邀请其细化努力与skill清单；语气支持、not指责，逐步链接情感与事实。

manifestations: Living alone纽约，适应新城市与竞争环境
担心被评判而not愿向朋友敞开
在压力下倾向独自硬撑
outcomes: 难以专注学习与投入日常活动

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向朋友寻求支持，转而独自硬撑
在压力期自我消耗（insomnia、反复担忧）

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 认为朋友会觉得自己夸张或not理解自己，从而回避敞开

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 过度Self-doubt，担心“给do not人添麻烦”
以灾难化与预测not yet来限制自身表达与行动

positive_force: Performed acceptably in some projects in the past, has some ability to learn and complete tasks
愿意尝试挑战负性思维与参与咨询
在纽约有少数朋友可成为潜在支持
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式突出
Self-doubt强烈，将成功归因于运气而negate自身能力
担心被评判导致回避求助与社交
Sleep disturbed，进一步降低专注与日常功能

target_behavior.behavior: 在项目/Exams approaching时出现强烈Anxiety与灾难化担忧（如“会破产、会失败、not得not退学”）
antecedent: 适应新城市与竞争性学业环境的压力
target_behavior.core_reason: The environmental pressure and economic burden brought by moving to New York and entering a highly competitive academy triggered catastrophic cognition about failure and financial collapse
target_behavior.function: Evades task pressure in the short term, tries to gain a sense of control and prevent worst cases through worry
target_behavior.consequence: 难以集中与投入学习，睡眠被打乱，整体Decline in sense of well-being与日常活动参与受限
